description: IsometryMatrix2/3 and SimilarityMatrix2/3 (products, inverses, inv_mul, divisions, point transforms, observer frames, lerp_slerp), the new operators of Isometry2/3 and Similarity2/3 (divisions, rotation_wrt_point, look_at_lh, mixed products), the Rotation operators with rotation-matrix poses, the exponential / sinh / cosh of real quaternions and Rotation2::renormalize

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar
